name: PdxAppLayout
description:
An application shell that places a header, side bars, main content and a footer on a CSS grid that
collapses responsively.

members.name: headerHeight
members.description: Header height (CSS value). Empty = no header.

members.name: footerHeight
members.description: Footer height (CSS value). Empty = no footer.

members.name: navbarCollapsedWidth
members.description:
Navbar collapsed width for mini mode. A non-zero rail keeps icon-only nav visible
when collapsed (set to '0px' explicitly for a fully-hidden navbar).

members.name: navbarBreakpoint
members.description: Breakpoint (px) below which navbar auto-collapses to overlay

members.name: asideWidth
members.description: Aside (right sidebar) width. Empty = no aside.

members.name: navbarFullHeight
members.description:
Full-height navbar: the left sidebar spans header+main+footer (logo lives in the
navbar), and the header only sits above main. Default false = header spans full width.

members.name: toggleNavbar
members.description: Open or close the navbar: the mobile drawer under the breakpoint, the `navbar-collapsed` prop above it.

members.name: openNavbar
members.description: Open the navbar, on either side of the breakpoint.

members.name: closeNavbar
members.description: Close the navbar, on either side of the breakpoint.

events.name: navbar-collapsed-change
events.description: Fired when the component writes `navbarCollapsed`. Does not bubble.

slots.description: The content placed inside the element.

cssParts.name: main
cssParts.description: The `<main class="pdx-app-main">` it wraps everything without a region in; the element that scrolls.

cssParts.name: overlay
cssParts.description: The backdrop behind the open drawer, below the breakpoint.

cssStates.name: bordered
cssStates.description: `withBorder` is set: a line between the regions.

cssStates.name: drawer
cssStates.description: Below `navbarBreakpoint`: the navbar is an overlay drawer, off screen until opened.

cssStates.name: drawer-open
cssStates.description: The drawer is open, with its backdrop.

cssStates.name: navbar-collapsed
cssStates.description: Above the breakpoint, the navbar is collapsed to its rail.

cssStates.name: navbar-gone
cssStates.description: Collapsed to a `0px` rail: the navbar takes no width at all.
